en-US: Build 220 repairs Linux persistence and install state: each environment keeps its own grow-only ext4 disk (8 GiB), caches and temporaries move to writable /floe/env paths, an installed or running guest no longer shows the download card, concurrent installs coalesce, and GNU ls -l no longer reports error 524. Linux environments gain an explicit "keep running in the background" switch with measured-only metrics and honest interruption reporting, task completion now uses one in-app banner in the foreground and authorized background alerts with deep links, and PPTX editing follows the engine's real edit entry with a visible-render gate (a presentation is ready only after a decoded document tile, otherwise it fails visibly with retry and the editing copy retained). Please retest Linux first download and disk/package reuse across restarts, ls -l, background stop/relaunch and metrics, task completion notifications, and PPTX edit/save/close.
zh-Hans: Build 220 修复 Linux 持久化与安装状态：每个环境保留自己的按需增长 ext4 磁盘（8 GiB），缓存与临时目录改到可写的 /floe/env，已安装或正在运行的客体不再显示下载卡片，并发安装会合并，GNU ls -l 不再报 524 错误。Linux 环境新增显式「在后台保持运行」开关，指标只上报实测值并如实报告中断；任务完成在前台只显示一条应用内横幅，后台提醒需实际授权并支持深链跳转；PPTX 编辑改为跟随引擎真实编辑入口并加入可见渲染门禁（演示文稿必须真正解码出文档图块才算就绪，否则显示可重试的失败并保留编辑副本）。请重点复测 Linux 首次下载与重启后的磁盘/软件包保留、ls -l、后台停止/重启与指标、任务完成通知，以及 PPTX 编辑保存退出。
